summary: Added Mintlify-native English/Korean language navigation, a Korean Cookbook landing page, a complete Korean translation of the EmbeddingGemma model recipe, a documented incremental localization workflow, and CI-enforced source/code-block integrity checks.

tests.what_was_measured: Verified the English default and Korean navigation, source-page mappings, full source commit SHAs, Hangul content, source existence, source freshness, and exact ordered preservation of fenced code blocks for two localized pages.
Adversarial regression coverage rejected English-only translated prose, a mutated serving command, and an abbreviated source commit while accepting a valid localized fixture.
Existing Cookbook authoring/configuration contracts and the CI-integrated localization contract remained valid.
Pinned Mintlify CLI 4.2.559 accepted the multilingual navigation schema and compiled all MDX pages.
Pinned Mintlify CLI found no broken internal links, anchors, or redirects, including Korean routes.
No whitespace errors were present in the patch.

gpu_execution.evidence: This contribution changes only Mintlify navigation, MDX documentation, and a Node.js static checker; it has no model/runtime numerical behavior to qualify on GPU.

remaining_limitations: The Korean pilot currently covers the Cookbook landing page and one complete model-specific guide (EmbeddingGemma); all other Cookbook pages remain English and are intentionally absent from Korean navigation.
No Korean native-speaker review was available in this environment; the contribution workflow explicitly requires fluent review before broader publication.

The upstream issue has no maintainer response selecting a localization structure, so this is a validated candidate based on Mintlify's documented native language navigation and the earlier multilingual discussion, not a claim of upstream acceptance.

A local mint dev preview was started but did not report ready before it was stopped; compilation and route/link correctness were independently validated with the pinned mint validate and broken-links commands.
GPU execution and native rebuilds are not applicable to this documentation-only change.
